map.边框样式按 solid / dashed / dotted / double /: Border styles rotate through eight kinds — solid / dashed / dotted / double / groove / ridge / inset / outset (pick one from the dropdown to fix it). Width and radius are random when left blank (width 1-8 px, radius 0-32 px) and fixed to your value when filled; colours come from a 10-colour palette by default, or a single chosen colour when "Use the colour on the left" is selected. A double border under 3 px is raised to 3 px (browsers render it as solid otherwise). With per-side enabled only one of border-top / border-right / border-bottom / border-left is emitted; four-side mode emits the border shorthand.
